name: Burt Clifton
notes: The RSPWF Top 200's 2000 entry for this name (#167, tagged UWC) matches the promotion's own served roster exactly: its World Heavyweight Champion of the same name, billed there from January through at least June 2000.
caption: UWC's own World Heavyweight Champion through the first half of 2000, teaming with Mike Masters as the Axis and placing #167 in the RSPWF Top 200 that year.

tenures.source: Billed as UWC World Heavyweight Champion across the promotion's own served broadcasts, teaming with Mike Masters as "the Axis" for the World Tag Team Championship and headlining a self-made roleplay of his own.

tenures.finisher: Dragon Suplex (per ring introduction; used for the pinfall over Omega)
tenures.note: Billed for Round 1 (bracket 2b, vs. Harbenneth Rookens and Kujo); commentary on the next show calls his advancement a “fluke,” implying a narrow Round 1 win the held record doesn't itself stage. On the 20 August Mothership, beat Omega in a Round 2 bout that included an outside chair shot from Omega's own manager “Barb.” Billed for a Round 3 semifinal against Silky Slim on 27 August.

tenures.source: The SEWF's own 2001 broadcasts, 14 January 2001 to 10 December 2001.
tenures.note: The fed's own title histories place this name on its roster from 4 January 2001.

identity.note: Consolidated under the standing rule (see the collision-rule erratum, 2026-08-30), on a join-test: the RSPWF Top 200's own 2001 entry for Burt Clifton carries the tag SEWF directly, matching this fed's own roster name exactly. No SEWF document itself names the RSPWF placement; the poll's own independent SEWF tag is the join. burt-clifton-uwc-rspwf is retired; its RSPWF Top 200 bestowals repoint here.

name: Mike Masters
notes: Known only from the RSPWF Top 200, the rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy newsgroup's own year-end poll. Placings and the poll's own federation tags, verbatim — 1999: #161, tagged ICW; 2000: #40, tagged IWC; 2001: #38, tagged RAW, SEWF. The SEWF tag of 2001 is a held promotion: the tenure is dated from that promotion's own broadcasts, which bill this name on its roster.
caption: Climbed the RSPWF Top 200 across three editions, from #161 in 1999 to #38 in 2001.

identity.note: The registry's own decorated-aka guard reads this name as a normalized substring match against shifty-faw. Recorded distinct, not merged: the only record this entity has is a placing in the RSPWF Top 200, which gives a ring name and a federation tag and nothing else — no dates, no roster, no URL, so three of the collision doctrine's own four signals are simply absent and the no-merge default holds. Every held-promotion roster the ranked names were checked against came back with zero overlap. Reopenable the moment either side gains a record the other can be checked against.

tenures.source: Billed on the promotion's own served broadcasts teaming with Burt Clifton as "the Axis" for the World Tag Team Championship; the same handler's own signature block names this character as shared across UWC and IWC.
